test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ashish went 1 km straight from his friend’s home, then turned left and moved 3 km straight. He again turned left and travelled 4 km, from there she turned left and moved 1 km. If He was moving in the west direction at last. then in which direction He's initially moved from her friend’s home?
solution:
From the given information: 

Ashish is moving 1k straight from his home but there is no direction is given in which direction he is moving. We can start by taking any direction. So we are starting with east direction.

After that he turned left and moved 3 km straight.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60be61609008d1ec9fcd035155858a4baecefdfeca2785983523a141ea7d7855.png] 

He then turned left and travelled 4 km, from there he turned left and moved 1 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eec661103915da31b92a9dbe8b53a1afd9b69ebb10979750e39b79210c06bb9b.png] 

So according to the question, if the final position of Ashish is in west direction then the starting position was in south direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eec661103915da31b92a9dbe8b53a1afd9b69ebb10979750e39b79210c06bb9b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "South".**
